# Rebuilding the bundled OCR CLI

1. Obtain this release's OCR corresponding-source ZIP and verify its SHA256 from the separate release manifest/SHA256SUMS. The original fixed Windows distribution and each shipped DLL are identified in RUNTIME_DISTRIBUTION_LOCK.json.
2. Unpack the archives/ directory. The MSYS2 MINGW-packages snapshot supplies the complete historical PKGBUILD directories, patches and package configuration; consult each component's recipe path in SOURCE_LOCK.json. The Tesseract source also contains its own CMake/Autotools build scripts and nsis/tesseract.nsi distribution recipe.
3. Prepare a Windows x64 MSYS2 MinGW build environment and the build-time tools/prerequisites listed by those historical PKGBUILDs. Build-time tool acquisition is separate from the end-user application, which is offline and needs no administrator installation.
4. Use the exact source versions and apply the patches from the corresponding recipe directories. GCC is the official 14.1.0 source commit cd0059a1976303638cea95f216de129334fc04d1; winpthreads is mingw-w64 f977e1c38299fd204b733650cba3726a244face6. Preserve all LICENSE/COPYING files.
5. Some supplied sources are exact commit archives rather than the original compressed release container. Map their top-level directories to the recipe's expected source directory. Record the input adaptation and update only the local source URL/container hash to the explicit supplied archive; do not pretend its container hash equals the recipe's original GNU/SourceForge release hash or silently disable integrity checks. Winlibs libiconv's unmodified release tree is under source/; the GNU Git mirror is a crosscheck rather than a replacement for those generated build files. Any shipped alternative rebuilt binary needs its own new manifest and qualification.
6. Build Tesseract 5.4.0 from the pinned UB-Mannheim source, retain the corresponding GPL/LGPL/Apache/permissive notices, and select only tesseract.exe plus its actual recursive non-system DLL imports. Compare the closure with RUNTIME_DISTRIBUTION_LOCK.json; this document does not promise compiler-output byte reproducibility.
7. Test --version, --list-langs with the pinned public language data, and real local TSV recognition. Preserve raw words/uncertainty as review clues; OCR does not prove original font, field ownership or native Illustrator fidelity.

Upstream source remains under its own licenses. Complete build recipes are supplied so recipients can inspect, modify and rebuild; no patched private customer material is required.
